categories.main_business_segments: Wuxi Longsheng Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three core business segments: automotive engine exhaust gas recirculation (EGR) systems, new energy vehicle (NEV) drive motor iron cores, and precision automotive parts. The company also actively explores emerging sectors such as aerospace precision manufacturing, low-altitude economy, and humanoid robots to diversify its business portfolio.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in EGR system development including EGR valves, coolers, controllers, and sensors, with proprietary innovations addressing corrosion and efficiency. In the NEV segment, it produces high-power density stators and permanent magnet rotors using processes like riveting, laser welding, and adhesive bonding. Precision parts manufacturing involves stamping, injection molding, and machining with a focus on lightweight and intelligent components. The company also employs intelligent manufacturing systems integrating PLM, ERP, SRM, WMS, and MES software to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic automotive manufacturers and first-tier suppliers such as BYD, Chery, Geely, GAC, Wuling, Dong'an Power, SAIC, Bosch, and Cummins. The company serves commercial vehicles, passenger cars, hybrid and pure electric vehicles, non-road engineering machinery, and natural gas heavy trucks. It also supplies aerospace and satellite manufacturers, drone producers, and humanoid robot developers, targeting both traditional automotive and emerging high-tech markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with headquarters and major production facilities in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, and subsidiaries in Chongqing and Guangxi. It has overseas operations including a now-closed subsidiary in Germany. Its sales are predominantly domestic, with over 98% of revenue generated in China, and a small portion from exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: Wuxi Longsheng Technology functions mainly as a midstream supplier in the automotive supply chain, producing key components such as EGR systems, motor iron cores, and precision stamped parts. It sources raw materials like steel and machined parts upstream and supplies directly to vehicle manufacturers and engine/motor producers downstream, positioning itself as a Tier 1 supplier with integrated upstream and downstream capabilities through its subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in emission reduction technologies, NEV motor components, and precision manufacturing. It invests in developing corrosion-resistant EGR valves, intelligent EGR systems for new emission standards, and advanced motor iron core structures. Strategic R&D also targets aerospace precision parts, humanoid robot components, and digital manufacturing platforms. The company emphasizes innovation through government-supported research centers, patent development, and collaboration with academic and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of automotive components including EGR systems, NEV motor iron cores, precision stamped and injection molded parts. The company operates on a product sales model with fixed-price contracts, recognizing revenue upon customer acceptance or delivery. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but may receive government subsidies and investment income as supplementary revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Wuxi Longsheng Technology holds a leading position in China's automotive parts industry, especially in EGR systems and NEV motor iron cores, breaking foreign monopolies in certain segments like natural gas EGR valves. It competes with domestic and international automotive parts suppliers, leveraging its integrated product portfolio, technological innovation, and strategic partnerships with major OEMs to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.4 billion, a 31.21% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 224 million, up 52.81%. Total assets reached nearly RMB 4 billion, growing 13.93% from the previous year. The company has demonstrated strong cash flow growth and continues to invest heavily in R&D and capacity expansion, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-value automotive components with advanced emission control and energy efficiency technologies. Its EGR systems offer broad compatibility with hybrid and fuel vehicles, while its NEV motor iron cores provide superior performance and efficiency. The firm differentiates through integrated solutions, domestic innovation breaking foreign monopolies, intelligent manufacturing, and strong customer service, positioning itself as a reliable Tier 1 supplier with comprehensive system capabilities.
